metadata.description: Walnut-Solana: private lending on Solana coordinated with Arcium MPC

accounts.name: operation_intent

accounts.name: signer

accounts.name: operation_intent

instructions.name: abandon_supply_flow

accounts.name: signer

accounts.name: operation_intent

instructions.name: abandon_unshield

accounts.name: signer

accounts.name: operation_intent

instructions.name: accept_admin

accounts.name: pending_admin

instructions.name: add_together
docs: Queues `add_together` with two encrypted `u8` inputs.

instructions.name: add_together_bounded_cu
docs: Queues `add_together` (reusing its circuit, accounts, and callback) but
with a caller-supplied `callback_cu_limit`. A deliberately tiny non-zero
limit makes the callback run out of compute units and the callback
transaction abort, so nothing is committed (Requirement 2.4,
compute-unit exhaustion). A `callback_cu_limit` of `0` would instead let
Arcium derive the limit from simulation and retry on exhaustion, so the
test must pass a small fixed value such as `1`.

instructions.name: add_together_callback
docs: Verifies the MPC output and emits the encrypted sum.

instructions.name: apply_position_delta
docs: Queues `apply_position_delta`: reads the Position payload already stored
in the account (the account-backed encrypted input), applies a
caller-supplied per-field delta inside MPC, and persists the updated
ciphertext via the callback. Running this repeatedly proves the
encrypted state persists and is consumable across computations.
Transaction-envelope note: here the stored state ciphertext is re-fed
through `ArgBuilder` instruction data (five 32-byte chunks), which is
small enough for the gate. The size-optimized alternative that keeps the
stored ciphertext out of the transaction is `ArgBuilder::packed_account`
(v0.16.0); Task 2.5 must measure and select between them.

instructions.name: apply_position_delta_callback
docs: Persists the updated Position payload produced by
`apply_position_delta`, replacing the previous encrypted revision.

instructions.name: apply_position_delta_comp_def

instructions.name: close_position

owner, and decrements `position_count`. `Active` Positions cannot
close yet (needs a zero-state proof computation).

accounts.name: owner

accounts.name: authority

instructions.name: disclose_position
docs: Owner-signed: queues `disclose_position`, which re-seals a field-masked
copy of the Position to `auditor_pubkey`. `mask` bit 0 free SOL, 1 free
USDC, 2 collateral, 3 supply shares, 4 debt shares. The Position is not
locked or changed. The callback writes the `Disclosure` PDA
`["disclosure", position, auditor]`, overwriting an earlier one.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The Position owner; signs, pays rent and the computation fee.

accounts.name: position
docs: The owner's own Position (read only; not locked).

accounts.name: operation_intent

accounts.name: disclosure
docs: PDA `["disclosure", position, auditor]`; created on first use and
overwritten by a later Disclosure to the same auditor.

instructions.name: disclose_position_callback
docs: Verifies the `disclose_position` output (sealed to the committed
auditor key) and writes the Disclosure only on `Applied`. `Stale`,
`Expired` and failed outcomes leave the previous Disclosure in place.

accounts.name: operation_intent

accounts.name: market

accounts.name: authority

Unauthenticated output (including Arcium's unsigned `Failure`) and any

instructions.name: initialize_market
docs: Creates the Market, Asset State, Pool State (`Initializing`), vault
authority, wSOL and USDC vaults, and Recovery Position. Only the
program upgrade authority may call it, and only once.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The program upgrade authority; pays for every account and becomes the
initial admin.

accounts.name: walnut_program
docs: loader state is parsed by `check_upgrade_authority`.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: to be the one the program account points at, owned by the loader.

accounts.name: wsol_mint
docs: The wSOL (native) mint.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The configured USDC mint.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token only.

instructions.name: initialize_position
docs: Owner-signed: creates the owner's Position in `Initializing` with the
Viewing Key registered at epoch zero, enforces the Position count cap
(incrementing `position_count`), creates the Operation Intent at
`sequence`, Locks the Position, and queues `init_position_state`, which
seals the zero `PositionSecret` to `viewing_pubkey`. `nonce` is a fresh
random client nonce for the `Shared` input; no ciphertext is sent.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The Position owner; pays rent and the computation fee.

instructions.name: lend_op
docs: Owner-signed lending operation on the encrypted Position: `op` 0 add
collateral, 1 withdraw collateral, 2 borrow, 3 repay, 4 supply, 5
withdraw supply. `amount` is a public USDC amount (lamports for ops 0
and 1). The Program accrues interest, checks pause, caps and liquidity,
computes the share amount publicly, reads the Pyth price from
`price_update` for ops 1 and 2 (any account otherwise), locks the
Position and queues `lend_op`. No caller-supplied price.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The Position owner; signs, pays rent and the computation fee.

accounts.name: asset_state
docs: Risk parameters, caps and pauses.

accounts.name: usdc_vault
docs: Read for the liquidity check of borrow and withdraw supply.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: The Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` account (`lending_pool.oracle`); read for ops
1 and 2, any account otherwise.

instructions.name: lend_op_callback
docs: Verifies the `lend_op` output. `Applied` stores the new state, bumps the
generation, releases the Lock, updates the pool totals and (for a
liquidation) sends the seized wSOL to the Liquidator. A refusal or an
unapplied attempt releases the Lock, stores nothing and (for a
liquidation) refunds the Liquidator's USDC. A health check only emits
`HealthChecked`. A failing vault transfer reverts the callback, so the
Intent stays queued for `abandon_lend_op`. Unauthenticated output and
binding mismatches revert.

accounts.name: operation_intent
docs: The attempt's Operation Intent; `classify_callback` verifies it.

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Permissionless liquidation. The Liquidator pays `repay_amount` USDC into
the vault now; the Program computes the debt burn and the wSOL seize
publicly from the accrued index, the Pyth low-bound price and the
liquidation bonus, locks the target Position and queues `lend_op` op 7.
`remaining_accounts` must be `[liquidator_usdc, liquidator_wsol]`.
On `applied` the callback sends the seized wSOL to the Liquidator; on
any other outcome (healthy, close factor, seize above collateral,
stale, expired) it refunds the USDC. `abandon_lend_op` refunds after
Lock expiry.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The Liquidator; signs, pays the repay amount, rent and the fee.

accounts.name: usdc_vault
docs: Receives the repay USDC.

accounts.name: position
docs: The target Position (locked until the callback).

accounts.name: operation_counter
docs: The Liquidator's sequence counter, created on first use.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: The Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` account (`lending_pool.oracle`).

instructions.name: liquidate_pool
docs: Permissionless private liquidation. The signer's own Position pays the
encrypted repay amount from its free USDC and receives the seized
lamports into its free SOL; the target's health is checked inside the
circuit. No token moves. Locks the Pool, the target and the
liquidator's Position and queues `liquidate_pool`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The liquidator; signs, pays rent and the computation fee, and owns
`liquidator_position`.

accounts.name: position
docs: The target (borrower) Position of this Market.

accounts.name: liquidator_position
docs: The liquidator's own Position: pays the repay amount, receives the
seized collateral.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: The Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` account (`lending_pool.oracle`).

instructions.name: liquidate_pool_callback
docs: Verifies the `liquidate_pool` output. `Applied` stores the Pool, the
target and the liquidator payloads and bumps all three generations.

accounts.name: operation_intent
docs: The attempt's Operation Intent; `classify_callback` verifies it.

instructions.name: liquidation_receipts
docs: Queues `liquidation_receipts`: one computation that reads a borrower and
a liquidator encrypted input and seals an independent encrypted Receipt
to each owner's Viewing Key. The callback emits both ciphertext groups so
each owner decrypts only their own Receipt (Requirement 2.3).

instructions.name: liquidation_receipts_callback
docs: Verifies the two-owner output and emits each owner's encrypted Receipt.
The generated output wraps the returned tuple as `field_0`, whose
`field_0` is the borrower's `SharedEncryptedStruct<2>` and `field_1` is
the liquidator's, each carrying its own effective key and nonce.

instructions.name: oversized_output
docs: Queues `oversized_output`: one encrypted `u64` input, a 48-field output.
The sealed output is too large for the node to fit in a single callback
transaction, so the computation fails with `OutputTooLarge` and the
success callback below never runs (Requirement 2.4).

instructions.name: oversized_output_callback
docs: Success callback for `oversized_output`. It is expected never to run
because the computation fails with `OutputTooLarge`; the localnet test
asserts `OversizedOutputEmitted` is not observed. The oversized
ciphertexts are ignored; only the nonce is relayed.

instructions.name: pool_band_callback
docs: Verifies the revealed band and stores it with the same rules as
`update_utilization_band_callback`.

accounts.name: asset_state
docs: Written only for an `Applied` decision.

accounts.name: operation_intent
docs: The attempt's Operation Intent; `classify_callback` verifies it.

instructions.name: pool_op
docs: Owner-signed private Pool operation: `op` 0 supply, 1 withdraw supply,
2 borrow, 3 repay. The amount and the share count arrive encrypted
(`input_*`); no argument, Intent field or event carries them. Accrues
the LendingPool to `accrue_to_ts`, reads the Pyth price for a borrow,
Locks the Pool and the Position and queues `pool_op`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The Position owner; signs, pays rent and the computation fee.

accounts.name: asset_state
docs: Risk parameters, caps and pauses.

accounts.name: lending_pool
docs: The public index authority; accrued at queue time.

accounts.name: pool_state
docs: The encrypted Pool; Locked by this operation.

accounts.name: position
docs: Locked by this operation.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: The Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` account (`lending_pool.oracle`); read for a
borrow, any account otherwise.

instructions.name: pool_op_callback
docs: Verifies the `pool_op` output. `Applied` stores the Pool and Position
payloads and bumps both generations; anything else stores nothing and
releases both Locks. Only the `applied` bit is public.

accounts.name: operation_intent
docs: The attempt's Operation Intent; `classify_callback` verifies it.

instructions.name: position_op
docs: Owner-signed demo operation on the encrypted Position: `op` 0 add
collateral, 1 withdraw collateral, 2 borrow, 3 repay. `price` (USDC base
units per SOL) is caller supplied (demo shortcut); the LTV comes from
the Asset State. Pure encrypted state update, no token moves.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The Position owner; signs, pays rent and the computation fee.

accounts.name: asset_state
docs: Read for the LTV.

instructions.name: position_op_callback
docs: Verifies the `position_op` output. `Applied` stores the new state,
bumps the generation and releases the Lock. A refusal (`Zero`),
`Stale`, and `Expired` release the Lock and store nothing.
Unauthenticated output and binding mismatches revert.

accounts.name: operation_intent
docs: The attempt's Operation Intent; `classify_callback` verifies it.

instructions.name: position_private
docs: Owner-signed private collateral operation: `op` 0 add collateral, 1
withdraw collateral. The lamport amount arrives encrypted. Reads the
Pyth price for a withdrawal, Locks the Position and queues
`position_private`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The Position owner; signs, pays rent and the computation fee.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: The Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` account; read for a withdrawal.

instructions.name: position_private_callback
docs: Verifies the `position_private` output (see `pool_op_callback`).

accounts.name: operation_intent
docs: The attempt's Operation Intent; `classify_callback` verifies it.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Admin-signed: names `new_admin` as pending admin (overwrites any
earlier proposal).

accounts.name: admin
docs: The current admin.

instructions.name: propose_config_change
docs: Risk-authority-signed: proposes one configuration group change.
`proposal_id` must be `asset_state.timelock.next_proposal_id`.

accounts.name: proposer
docs: The risk authority.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the proposal rent; may be the proposer.

instructions.name: queue_pool_state_init
docs: Queues `init_pool_state`, which seals the all-zero Pool payload to the
MXE. Admin-only and only while the Pool is `Initializing`. Re-queueing
after a failed computation is allowed; the first authenticated callback
activates the Pool and later ones are no-ops.

instructions.name: recover_empty_pool
docs: Admin-signed: reclassifies an empty Pool's provable dust residue as
Reserves so the treasury can withdraw it and supply can reopen. See
`state::recovery` for the review notes. Locks the Pool, accrues the
accounting Borrow Index, creates the Intent at `sequence` (Pool-owned
counter), and queues `recover_empty_pool`. No token moves.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The Market admin; signs, pays rent and the computation fee.

accounts.name: sign_pda_account
docs: Not init_if_needed (see `SupplyFlowQueue`).

accounts.name: asset_state
docs: Written: the accounting Borrow Index accrues at queue time.

accounts.name: pool_state
docs: Locked by this operation.

accounts.name: operation_counter
docs: The Pool-owned Intent counter (created on first use).

instructions.name: recover_empty_pool_callback
docs: Verifies the `recover_empty_pool` output. `Applied` stores the Pool
payload, advances the accounted index, bumps the generation, and
releases the Lock. `Zero`, `Stale`, and `Expired` release the Lock and
store nothing. Unauthenticated output and binding mismatches revert,
so the Intent stays `Queued` for `abandon_recover_empty_pool`.

accounts.name: operation_intent
docs: The attempt's Operation Intent; `classify_callback` verifies it.

instructions.name: refund_shield
docs: Owner-signed and not pausable: refunds a `Deposited` Pending Shield
whose active attempt ended without a credit; exactly the recorded
amount leaves the vault, signed by the vault-authority PDA.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The Pending Shield owner. `state::shield` checks it.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Signs the vault transfer.

accounts.name: active_intent
docs: The Pending Shield's active attempt; it must be terminal.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The asset mint (classic SPL Token only).

accounts.name: vault
docs: The asset vault.

accounts.name: destination
docs: A token account of the asset owned by the Pending Shield owner.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token only; Token-2022 is rejected.

instructions.name: renew_guardian_pause
docs: Risk-authority-signed: extends the active guardian pause.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The guardian (`guardian_pause`) or the risk authority (the others).

instructions.name: reserve_withdrawal
docs: Treasury-authority-signed: requests a public all-or-zero USDC `amount`
from the Pool's Reserves to the configured treasury token account.
Requires an `Active` Pool with a free Lock, the `WITHDRAW_SUPPLY` pause
off, and a configured treasury account owned by the treasury
authority. Accrues the accounting Borrow Index, creates the Intent at
`sequence` (Pool-owned counter), Locks the Pool, and queues
`reserve_withdrawal`. No token moves until the callback approves.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The treasury authority; signs, pays rent and the computation fee.

accounts.name: market
docs: Read for the roles and the treasury account; the signer must be the
treasury authority (`state::reserve_withdrawal` checks).

accounts.name: asset_state
docs: Written: the accounting Borrow Index accrues at queue time.

accounts.name: pool_state
docs: Locked by this operation.

accounts.name: operation_counter
docs: The Pool-owned Intent counter (created on first use).

accounts.name: destination
docs: The treasury token account; `state::reserve_withdrawal` checks it is
the Market's configured one. It is bound in the Intent.

instructions.name: reserve_withdrawal_callback
docs: Verifies the `reserve_withdrawal` output with the Task 3.3 helpers.
`Applied` stores the new Pool payload, sets the accounted index, bumps
the Pool generation, releases the Lock, and transfers exactly the
approved amount from the USDC vault to the committed treasury account,
signed by the vault-authority PDA. `Zero`, `Stale`, and `Expired`
release the Lock and move nothing. A terminal Intent is a no-op.
Unauthenticated output and any binding mismatch revert, so the Intent
stays `Queued` for `abandon_reserve_withdrawal`.

accounts.name: operation_intent
docs: The attempt's Operation Intent; `classify_callback` verifies it.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The USDC mint (bound in the Intent).

accounts.name: vault
docs: The USDC vault (bound in the Intent).

accounts.name: destination
docs: The committed treasury token account (bound in the Intent).

accounts.name: vault_authority

instructions.name: rotate_position_key
docs: Owner-signed and not pausable: queues the re-encryption of the stored
Position payload from the current Viewing Key to `new_viewing_pubkey`.
The owner states the epochs and the current key it expects
(`expected_new_epoch` must be `expected_old_epoch + 1`); the Intent
commits them with the new key, the stored payload, and the sequence.
Requires an `Active` Position with a free Lock. Nothing changes until
the callback applies, so the old key stays valid meanwhile.

instructions.name: rotate_position_key_callback
docs: Verifies the `rotate_position_key` output with the Task 3.3 helpers.
`Applied` stores the re-sealed payload, the new Viewing public key, and
the incremented epoch together, bumps the generation, and releases the
Lock. `Stale` and `Expired` release the Lock and change nothing (the
old key stays valid). A terminal Intent is a no-op. Unauthenticated
output and any binding mismatch (including an output sealed to a key
other than the committed one) revert, so the Intent stays `Queued` for
`abandon_rotation`.

instructions.name: rotate_viewing_key

current Viewing Key and re-encrypts it to `new_pub_key`. The Position PDA
is seeded by the owner, so only the owner's signature can rotate the key
(Requirement 5.11). `probe_ciphertext` is a throwaway value encrypted
under the new key that only carries the new key into the circuit.

instructions.name: rotate_viewing_key_callback

new public key, and increments `viewing_key_epoch` (Requirement 5.11).
After this callback the stored payload decrypts under the new key only.

opens the Pending Shield at `shield_sequence` (`Deposited`, attempt 1),
creates the Shield Intent at `sequence`, Locks the Position, and
queues `shield_credit`. Pausable (`SHIELD`).

Lock, and marks the Pending Shield `Credited`. `Zero` (overflow),
`Stale`, and `Expired` release the Lock and leave it `Deposited`. A
terminal Intent or an old attempt is a no-op. Unauthenticated output
and any binding mismatch revert, so the Intent stays `Queued` for
`abandon_shield`.

or withdraws `requested` supply shares (`is_withdraw = true`). Requires
an `Active` Position and Pool with free Locks and the matching pause
off. Accrues the accounting Borrow Index, creates the Intent at
`sequence`, Locks the Pool and the Position together, and queues
`supply_flow`. No token moves: only encrypted balances change.

`Expired` release both Locks and store nothing. A terminal Intent is a
no-op. Unauthenticated output and any binding mismatch revert, so the

instructions.name: unshield
docs: Owner-signed: requests a public `amount` of `asset` back to
`destination`, a token account of the asset's mint owned by the owner.
Requires an `Active` Position with a free Lock and the `UNSHIELD`
pause off. Creates the Unshield Intent at `sequence`, Locks the
Position, and queues `unshield`. No token moves until the callback
approves the amount.

delivers wSOL, and native SOL unwrap is a separate owner-signed
transaction (`buildUnwrapWsolTransaction` in the SDK).

instructions.name: unshield_callback

`Applied` (approved) stores the new state, bumps the generation,
releases the Lock, and transfers exactly the approved amount from the
vault to the committed destination, signed by the vault-authority PDA.
`Zero` (insufficient balance), `Stale`, and `Expired` release the Lock
and move nothing. A terminal Intent is a no-op. Unauthenticated output
and any binding mismatch (including a substituted destination) revert,
so the Intent stays `Queued` for `abandon_unshield`.

instructions.name: update_pool_band
docs: Permissionless: queues the light `pool_band` circuit, which reveals only
the private Pool's utilization band at the LendingPool borrow index
(ADR-0004). Same Intent rules as `update_utilization_band` (Pool-owned
counter, no Lock); the callback stores the band on the Asset State.

docs: Anyone; pays rent and the computation fee.

accounts.name: pool_state

instructions.name: update_utilization_band
docs: Permissionless: queues the read-only utilization-band computation. It
reads the Pool's encrypted Cash and Debt Shares at the public
accounting Borrow Index and reveals only the band index. It neither
checkpoints nor Locks the Pool and changes no generation. The Intent
captures the Pool generation, Asset State generation, rate epoch, and
accounting index; the Pool-owned counter supplies `sequence`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays rent and the computation fee.

accounts.name: pool_state

accounts.name: lending_pool

at its borrow index instead of the Asset State's accounting index.

accounts.name: operation_counter

accounting index still match; `Stale`, `Expired`, and failed outcomes
store nothing. A terminal Intent is a no-op. Unauthenticated output and
any binding mismatch revert, so the Intent stays `Queued`.

Layout (offsets include the 8-byte Anchor discriminator; 211 bytes):
discriminator 0..8, `owner` 8..40, `position` 40..72,
`source_token_account` 72..104, `asset` 104, `status` 105, `bump` 106,
`amount` 107..115, `sequence` 115..123, `attempt_sequence` 123..131,
`active_intent` 131..163, `active_computation_offset` 163..171,
`captured_position_generation` 171..179, `reserved` 179..211. Integers are
little-endian. Later tasks may only take bytes from `reserved`.

fields.name: owner
docs: The Position owner who deposited.

fields.name: position
docs: The Position to credit. Part of the PDA seeds.

fields.name: source_token_account

fields.name: asset
docs: The deposited asset.

fields.name: status
docs: Lifecycle status.

fields.name: bump
docs: The PDA bump.

fields.name: amount
docs: The public deposited amount in base units. Never zero.

fields.name: sequence

fields.name: attempt_sequence

fields.name: active_intent
docs: The Operation Intent of the current attempt.

fields.name: active_computation_offset
docs: The computation offset of the current attempt.

fields.name: captured_position_generation
docs: The Position generation the current attempt captured.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for later fields; always zero.

types.name: PendingShieldStatus
docs: Pending Shield lifecycle. Zeroed data reads as `Uninitialized`. The tag is
the Borsh variant index; append-only.

types.name: PoolBandOutput

as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: PoolOpOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: PoolState
docs: The USDC Pool State (design: "Pool State").
The Task 3.1 coordination fields keep their offsets; Task 4.1 appends the
Pool fields after `bump`.

fields.name: coordination
docs: The Pool's generation and writer Lock.

fields.name: bump
docs: The PDA bump.

fields.name: layout_version
docs: Layout version (`market::LAYOUT_VERSION`).

fields.name: status
docs: Lifecycle status.

fields.name: market
docs: The owning Market.

fields.name: accounted_borrow_index
docs: The Borrow Index the encrypted payload was last checkpointed at (WAD).

fields.name: encrypted
docs: The `Enc<Mxe, PoolSecret>` payload. All zero until `Active`.

types.name: PoolStateActivated
docs: Emitted by the `init_pool_state` callback when the encrypted zero Pool
payload is stored and the Pool becomes `Active`. Only the generation and
the MXE output nonce are public.

types.name: PoolStatus
docs: Lifecycle of the Pool State. Zeroed data reads as `Uninitialized`.

types.name: Position
docs: A production Position (design: "Position").
The Task 3.1 coordination fields and the Task 4.5 `has_debt` flag keep
their offsets; Task 5.1 appends the remaining design fields after
`has_debt`. The design's `next_operation_seq` is the separate per-owner
`OperationCounter` PDA (see `operation::seeds`).

fields.name: owner
docs: The Position owner.

fields.name: coordination
docs: The Position's generation and writer Lock.

fields.name: bump
docs: The PDA bump.

fields.name: has_debt
docs: Public "this Position has debt" flag (Requirement 4.11, Task 4.5). It
changes only through `market::caps::settle_debt_intent`, driven by the
zero/nonzero transition a verified callback reveals; never the amount.

fields.name: status
docs: Lifecycle status (Task 5.1).

fields.name: market
docs: The Market this Position belongs to. Part of the PDA seeds.

fields.name: viewing_pubkey
docs: The owner's x25519 Viewing public key; the payload is sealed to it.

fields.name: viewing_key_epoch
docs: The Viewing Key epoch, starting at zero (Requirement 5.10).

fields.name: frozen
docs: Public freeze flag (health checks, Task 11).

fields.name: freeze_epoch
docs: Freeze epoch (Task 11).

fields.name: frozen_since_slot
docs: Slot of the current freeze (Task 11).

fields.name: next_disclosure_seq
docs: Next Disclosure sequence (Task 13).

fields.name: encrypted_state
docs: The `Enc<Shared, PositionSecret>` payload. All zero until `Active`.

fields.name: next_shield_seq
docs: The sequence of this Position's next Pending Shield (Task 5.2). Taken
from the first 8 reserved bytes, so existing zeroed data reads as 0.
Advanced only by `state::pending_shield::open_pending_shield`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for later fields; always zero.

types.name: PositionActivated
docs: Emitted by the `init_position_state` callback when the encrypted zero
state is stored and the Position becomes `Active`. `nonce` is the stored
output nonce (little-endian); the client decrypts locally.

types.name: PositionClosed
docs: Emitted by `close_position`: the `InitFailed` Position was closed and its
rent returned to the owner. `PositionCountChanged` is emitted with it.

types.name: PositionCountChanged
docs: Emitted when a Position PDA is created and `position_count` increments
(Task 4.5 rule `market::on_position_initialized`; emitted by the Task 5
Position initialization instruction).

types.name: PositionDisclosed
docs: Emitted by the `disclose_position` callback when the Disclosure is stored.

types.name: PositionInitFailed
docs: Emitted when an initialization attempt ends without storing state
(callback `Stale`, `Expired`, `Failed`, or `Zero`, or permissionless
abandonment). The Position is `InitFailed`: the owner may retry or close.
`intent_status` is the Intent's terminal status.

types.name: PositionInitQueued
docs: Emitted when a Position initialization attempt is queued: by
`initialize_position` (`retry == false`) and `retry_position_init`
(`retry == true`).

types.name: PositionOpAbandoned
docs: Emitted by `abandon_position_op` (any signer, after Lock expiry).

types.name: PositionOpApplied
docs: Emitted by the `position_op` callback when the operation applied.

types.name: PositionOpOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: PositionOpQueued
docs: Emitted by `position_op` when the operation was queued. `op` and `amount`
are public by design; balances stay encrypted.

types.name: PositionOpRejected
docs: Emitted by the `position_op` callback when the circuit refused the
operation or the attempt ended without applying (`intent_status`).

types.name: PositionPrivateOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: PositionStateStored
docs: Emitted by the Task 2.2 Position callbacks when a new encrypted revision is
persisted. The payload stays encrypted in the account; only the Position
key, the new revision counter, and the output nonce are public. The nonce
lets a client locate and decrypt the stored ciphertext locally.

types.name: PositionStatus
docs: Lifecycle of a production Position (Task 5.1). Zeroed data reads as
`Uninitialized`.
Transitions (rules in `state::position`):
```text
(created) -> Initializing          initialize_position
Initializing -> Active             Applied callback
Initializing -> InitFailed         Stale/Expired/Failed callback, or abandonment
InitFailed -> Initializing         retry_position_init (owner)
InitFailed -> (closed)             close_position (owner)

types.name: PrivateOpAbandoned
docs: Emitted by the abandonment of a private operation after Lock expiry.

types.name: PrivateOpQueued
docs: Emitted when a private operation is queued. `kind` is the Intent kind tag
and `op` the public operation code; amounts stay encrypted.

types.name: PrivateOpSettled
docs: Emitted by a private operation callback. `applied` is the one revealed bit.

types.name: ProposalStatus
docs: Status of a configuration proposal. `Executed` and `Cancelled` are final.

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Governance-controlled protocol parameters, stored on [`super::ClockAccount`] so every
instruction that enforces one of them already has the account in hand (no account-list
changes for clients). Only values that do not size any account layout live here; anything
that does (activation delays, Merkle-tree heights, ...) stays a compile-time constant.
Changed via `set_protocol_config`, signed by `ClockAccount::protocol_config_authority`.

types.name: RateParams
docs: Interest-rate parameters (annualized basis points) and the maximum age of a
utilization-band observation before risk-increasing actions return zero.

fields.name: base_rate_bps
docs: Borrow rate at zero utilization.

fields.name: slope1_bps
docs: Slope up to the optimal utilization.

fields.name: slope2_bps
docs: Slope above the optimal utilization.

fields.name: optimal_utilization_bps
docs: Kink of the rate curve.

fields.name: band_max_age_slots
docs: Maximum age of the utilization-band observation.

types.name: RecoverEmptyPoolOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: ReserveWithdrawalAbandoned
docs: Emitted by `abandon_reserve_withdrawal` (any signer, after Lock expiry).

types.name: ReserveWithdrawalApproved
docs: Emitted by the `reserve_withdrawal` callback when the request was approved,
the new Pool state stored, and exactly `amount` transferred.

types.name: ReserveWithdrawalNotApplied
docs: Emitted by the `reserve_withdrawal` callback when nothing moved: the
circuit approved zero (`Zero`), or the attempt was `Stale`, `Expired`, or
`Failed`. The Pool state is unchanged and the Lock is released.

types.name: ReserveWithdrawalOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: ReserveWithdrawalQueued
docs: Emitted by `reserve_withdrawal` when it queues (Task 7.5). The requested
amount and the treasury account are public by design.

types.name: RiskParams
docs: Risk parameters (Requirement 4.12). Ratios are basis points (10,000 = 1.0).
Task 4.4 adds bounds, maximum movement per change, and the Requirement 4.13
cross-bound check for every governed change.

fields.name: ltv_bps
docs: Maximum loan-to-value for borrow and collateral withdrawal.

fields.name: liquidation_threshold_bps
docs: Liquidation Threshold.

fields.name: liquidation_bonus_bps
docs: Liquidation bonus paid in collateral.

fields.name: target_health_factor_bps
docs: Target Health Factor after a partial liquidation.

fields.name: close_factor_bps
docs: Maximum share of debt one partial liquidation may repay.

fields.name: reserve_factor_bps
docs: Share of interest added to Reserves.

fields.name: oracle_max_age_seconds
docs: Maximum Pyth price age.

fields.name: oracle_max_confidence_bps
docs: Maximum Pyth confidence as a share of price.

fields.name: decision_expiry_slots
docs: Decision Expiry distance from the queue slot.

types.name: RoleAuthorityChanged
docs: Emitted by every separated-role setter (Task 4.2): risk, treasury,
guardian, and the recorded upgrade authority. `changed_by` is the signer
that authorized the change.

types.name: RoleKind
docs: The separately configured authorities a setter changes. Carried in
[`crate::events::RoleAuthorityChanged`].

types.name: RotatePositionKeyOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: RotateViewingKeyOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: SetUnset
docs: Utility struct to store a value that needs to be set by a certain number of participants (keys
in our case). Once all participants have set the value, the value is considered set and we only
store it once.

types.name: ShieldAbandoned
docs: Emitted by `abandon_shield` (any signer, after Lock expiry). The Pending
Shield stays `Deposited` and its tokens stay in the vault.

types.name: ShieldAsset
docs: The shielded asset. The tag is the Borsh variant index; append-only.

types.name: ShieldCreditFailed
docs: Emitted by the `shield_credit` callback when the attempt ended without a
credit (`Zero`, `Stale`, or `Expired`). The Pending Shield stays
`Deposited`: the owner may retry or refund.

types.name: ShieldCreditOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: ShieldCredited
docs: Emitted by the `shield_credit` callback when the credit is stored and the
Pending Shield is `Credited`. `nonce` is the stored output nonce
(little-endian); the owner decrypts locally.

types.name: ShieldQueued
docs: Emitted by `shield` after the exact public `amount` moved from
`source_token_account` into `vault` and the first credit attempt was
queued. `asset` and `amount` are public by design (Requirement 5.5).

types.name: ShieldRefunded
docs: Emitted by `refund_shield`: exactly `amount` moved from `vault` back to
`destination` and the Pending Shield is `Refunded`.

types.name: ShieldRetried
docs: Emitted by `retry_shield` when a new credit attempt is queued for a
`Deposited` Pending Shield whose previous attempt ended without a credit.

types.name: SpikePosition
docs: A Position account holding persistent encrypted state for the feasibility
gate.

fields.name: owner
docs: The Position owner (payer of the initialization).

fields.name: viewing_pubkey
docs: The Viewing public key the payload is encrypted to (the
`SharedEncryptedStruct::encryption_key`). Equivalent to the design's
`viewing_pubkey`.

fields.name: viewing_key_epoch
docs: The Viewing Key epoch. Initialization uses epoch zero; rotation
(Task 5.5) increments it. Stored here so the spike account shape matches
the design.

fields.name: revision
docs: A local revision counter bumped on each stored write. Distinct from the
coordination `generation` modelled by the Task 2.1 state machine; it
lets the test confirm every computation produced a fresh revision.

fields.name: state
docs: The current encrypted payload.

fields.name: bump
docs: The PDA bump.

types.name: SumEvent
docs: Emitted by the scaffold `add_together` callback. The sum stays encrypted
to the caller's shared key; only the ciphertext and nonce are public.

types.name: SupplyFlowAbandoned
docs: Emitted by `abandon_supply_flow` (any signer, after Lock expiry).

types.name: SupplyFlowApplied
docs: Emitted by the `supply_flow` callback when both payloads were stored.
Carries no balance, share, or claim amount.

types.name: SupplyFlowNotApplied
docs: Emitted when the request resolved `Zero`, `Stale`, `Expired`, or `Failed`.
Nothing was stored; both Locks were released.

types.name: SupplyFlowOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: SupplyFlowQueued
docs: Emitted by `supply_flow` when it queues a supply or withdrawal (Task 8).
The request is a public argument of the computation in v1 (see ADR-0002).

types.name: TimelockState
docs: Timelock state for configuration changes (Requirement 4.5). Proposals
live in `ConfigProposal` PDAs; rules are in `market::config` (Task 4.4).

fields.name: delay_seconds
docs: Minimum delay between proposal and execution.

fields.name: next_proposal_id
docs: Identifier the next proposal receives.

types.name: TreasuryUsdcAccountChanged
docs: Emitted by `set_treasury_usdc_account` (admin).

types.name: UnshieldAbandoned
docs: Emitted by `abandon_unshield` (any signer, after Lock expiry).

types.name: UnshieldApproved
docs: Emitted by the `unshield` callback when the circuit approved the request:
exactly `amount` moved from `vault` to `destination` and the new state is
stored. `nonce` is the stored output nonce (little-endian).

types.name: UnshieldFailed
docs: Emitted by the `unshield` callback when the attempt ended without a
transfer (`Expired`, `Stale`, or `Failed`).

types.name: UnshieldOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: UnshieldQueued
docs: Emitted by `unshield` when the request was queued. `asset`, `amount`, and
`destination` are public by design (Requirement 5.7): the outgoing SPL
transfer is public. Nothing has moved yet.

types.name: UnshieldZero
docs: Emitted by the `unshield` callback when the circuit approved zero
(insufficient free balance). Nothing moved and nothing was stored.

types.name: UpdateUtilizationBandOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: UtilizationBandNotApplied
docs: Emitted by the `update_utilization_band` callback when nothing was stored
(`Stale`, `Expired`, or `Failed`). The status says which.

types.name: UtilizationBandQueued
docs: Emitted when `update_utilization_band` queues a computation (Task 7.2).
Public values only: the band computation reads encrypted Cash and debt but
reveals only the band index.

types.name: UtilizationBandUpdated
docs: Emitted by the `update_utilization_band` callback when the revealed band
was current and stored (`written`) or superseded by a newer observation.

types.name: VaultAuthority
docs: The PDA that owns the wSOL and USDC vault token accounts and signs vault
transfers (`["vault_authority", market]`).

fields.name: market
docs: The owning Market. All zero means not yet written.

fields.name: bump
docs: The PDA bump.

types.name: ViewingKeyRotated
docs: Emitted by the Task 2.3 `rotate_viewing_key` callback when a Position is
re-encrypted to a new Viewing Key. Commits the old and new key epochs and
public keys (Requirement 5.11). The re-encrypted payload stays in the
account; only the epoch/public-key transition and the new output nonce are
public.

types.name: ViewingKeyRotationAbandoned
docs: Emitted by `abandon_rotation` (any signer, after Lock expiry).

types.name: ViewingKeyRotationApplied
docs: Emitted by the `rotate_position_key` callback when the payload, public key,
and epoch changed together. `nonce` is the stored output nonce
(little-endian). This is the production counterpart of the spike's
`ViewingKeyRotated`.

types.name: ViewingKeyRotationFailed
docs: Emitted by the `rotate_position_key` callback when the attempt ended
without a rotation (`Expired`, `Stale`, or `Failed`). The old key, epoch,
and payload are unchanged.

types.name: ViewingKeyRotationQueued
docs: Emitted by `rotate_position_key` when the rotation was queued. The old and
new epochs and public keys are public by design (Requirement 5.11); no
balance is. Nothing has changed yet: the old key stays valid until the
callback applies.
